time_axis: asset sample n at 44100 Hz; contract times are float seconds n/44100 from track.wav sample 0; stem feature frame i covers samples [i*882, i*882+2048) of the stem WAV (hop 882 = floor(44100/50), n_fft 2048); the PRISM adapter places frame i at round(i*1e6/50) us, i.e. at the frame's START sample, so a feature describes audio up to 46.4 ms (2048 samples) AFTER its timestamp (centre at +23.2 ms). Flag for M2-compose: no delay compensation is applied anywhere; do not add one twice.
fps_note: hop 882 samples at 44.1 kHz = exactly 50.000 fps (20.000 ms); integer, no drift

rhythm.beats.source: Beat This! final0 on full mix, dbn=False

rhythm.downbeats.source: Beat This! final0, snapped onto beats

rhythm.beat_positions.source: Trinity rhythm_provider (counts beats since last downbeat, 70 ms tolerance)

rhythm.bpm.note: global; tempo changes are not represented

rhythm.time_signature.note: inferred, not measured; denominator is a constant

structure.segments.source: allin1-trinity harmonix-all 8-fold ensemble on Demucs stems
structure.segments.quality: labels are model inferences (Harmonix taxonomy), not ground truth; no per-segment confidence is emitted

stems.<stem>.rms.source: Demucs htdemucs stem (int16 WAV), mono = mean(L,R)
stems.<stem>.rms.units: linear RMS of PCM float in [-1,1] (not dB)

stems.<stem>.onset_strength.normalisation: PER STEM, PER WHOLE TRACK: divided by that stem's 99th percentile, clipped at 1. A passage slice keeps the whole-track scale.
stems.<stem>.onset_strength.delay: frame starts at timestamp; frame 0 is 0.0 by construction (no previous frame)

stems.<stem>.band_energy_low.units: linear magnitude (unnormalised FFT sum scale, not dB, not 0-1)

not_emitted.per-feature validity/confidence: NOT PRODUCED by Trinity k1-lite; absent, not zero
not_emitted.blobs (macros/activations/embeddings/spe: null by design at k1-lite (organs.lock note: derive_macros_from_activations returns None)
not_emitted.tonal / notes / chords: NOT RUN (analyze_track --tonal not requested; BasicPitch not part of locked path)
not_emitted.full-mix stem_features: NOT PRODUCED (Trinity stem pack covers the four Demucs stems only)
not_emitted.vocal activity / phrase detection: NOT PRODUCED; vocals.rms is energy of a separated stem, which contains bleed

separator_caveats: Demucs stems are estimates with bleed, not isolated instruments. Written as int16 WAV. Demucs clip-mode 'rescale' divided vocals, drums and other by an UNRECORDED factor (their peaks are exactly 1/1.01 = 0.9901; raw/stem_check.json), so absolute rms/band_energy levels are NOT comparable across those stems or to bass; per-stem relative shape is intact. Demucs ran with one unseeded random shift (Trinity drops --demucs-shifts 0), so stems are not reproducible from source; this cache is the reference copy.
